title: Pablo Exclusive Mango Ice Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Mango Ice Nicotine Pouches deliver a tropical hit of juicy Mango balanced by a brisk Icy finish. This blend combines fruity sweetness with a cool exhale for a refreshing and flavourful experience. Each slim pouch delivers 30mg of nicotine and is designed to sit discreetly under the upper lip. Tobacco-free and vapourless, Pablo pouches provide a clean and potent alternative for those seeking a smoke-free solution. With 20 pouches in every can, Pablo Mango Ice is perfect for experienced pouch users looking for a strong nicotine hit with a tropical twist. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
